title: Roman To Integer
prompt: Given a valid Roman numeral in uppercase letters for a number from 1 to 3999, return its integer value. The letters I, V, X, L, C, D, and M stand for 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500, and 1000. Values are added from left to right, except that a letter placed directly before a letter of larger value is subtracted instead of added.
